independence.authoring_basis: real-world outcome scenarios written independently from runtime wording
independence.label_access_policy: frozen non-tuning holdout; failures may be measured but not inspected for catalog edits
independence.ui_policy: synthetic app-agnostic surfaces; canonical labels appear only as UI choices, never as goal labels
